 Convenient Ways to Get Your Cannabis

 
 

 
 
 
 Finding your perfect strain is our mission. We just love elevating the quality of life and are more than happy to smooth your path with conveniences such as online ordering, in-store pickup, and curbside pickup.

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 Shop Cannabis In-Store or Order Online for Pickup & Delivery

 
 

 
 
 
 Shop Cannabis In-Store or Order Online for Pickup & Delivery

 As the first legal, licensed cannabis dispensary in San Pedro, We Roll Up continues to pioneer change for the better — and that includes bringing the dispensary experience directly to your door with our convenient, discreet, and reliable delivery service. We believe access should never be a barrier, which is why we’ve made it easier than ever to get exactly what you need, whether you prefer to browse our welcoming in-store environment or place a delivery order from the comfort of home. Our doors are open and our delivery runs seven days a week, because your schedule matters and your comfort matters even more. We serve anyone and everyone from all walks of life — recreational novices trying cannabis for the first time, devoted enthusiasts who know their preferences inside and out, medicinal patients counting on consistency and care, locals who’ve made us part of their weekly routine, and visitors discovering everything San Pedro has to offer. If you’re 21 or older with a valid ID, getting what you need from We Roll Up has never been simpler — shop in store or place your delivery order and let us handle the rest. Our knowledgeable, passionate, and genuinely helpful staff members are committed to making every interaction exceptional, whether they’re guiding you through options at the counter or delivering your order straight to your doorstep with the efficiency, discretion, and care you deserve. However you choose to shop with us, the We Roll Up experience comes to you.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 A Community Built Around Cannabis

 For recreational and medicinal marijuana, We Roll Up is where potential and opportunity meet. We bring communities together through a supportive atmosphere and quality products that enrich socialization, bring medicinal relief, and provide a variety of options to suit all needs. Stop by from anywhere across the country and discover the best of cannabinoids, terpenes and effects.

Accessibility Statement

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 Date: January 10, 2022

 Accessibility conformance status

 We Roll Up is committed to accessibility and strives to ensure its services are accessible to the broadest circle of people, including those with disabilities. This website is designed with the goal of conforming to the principles of the World Wide Web Consortium’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1) 2.1 Level AA.

 Accessibility feedback

 Accessibility is powered by your willingness to share your experience on our site. If you have any specific questions, concerns, or general feedback about the accessibility of any of the content on our website, please contact us. Please be sure to specify the page/URL of concern, and we will get back to you in a timely manner.

 Email: [email] 

 Physical address: 1705 S Gaffey Street 

 Technical specifications

 The accessibility of We Roll Up relies on the following technologies: 

 
 HTML

 WAI-ARIA

 CSS

 JavaScript

 
 Accessibility features

 We Roll Up reaches beyond compliance, providing usability improvements that benefit all users including those that rely on assistive technology. Accessibility features on our website include and are not limited to: 

 
 Keyboard accessibility

 Sufficient color contrast

 Alternative text

 Text-zoom

 
 Technology is constantly evolving, and new techniques to implement web accessibility are increasingly available. We will continue to review our website and apply additional accessibility as needed.

pages.bodyText:
Education

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 Cannabis Education at We Roll Up

 At We Roll Up , we believe that informed consumers make the best decisions for their health, lifestyle, and overall well-being. As San Pedro ‘s first licensed cannabis dispensary, we have always prioritized education as a cornerstone of our mission. Whether you are a first-time visitor exploring a weed dispensary for the very first time or a seasoned connoisseur looking to deepen your understanding of cannabinoid science, our knowledgeable and diverse team is here to guide you through every question and curiosity you bring through our doors. We are open seven days a week and proudly serve customers from Carson, San Pedro, Wilmington, Westchester, Rancho Palos Verdes, Mar Vista, Del Rey, Lomita, Palos Verdes Estates, Playa Vista, Marina Del Ray, Fox Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rolling Hills, and LAX and beyond, ensuring that cannabis education remains accessible to everyone in California.

 Understanding the Cannabis Plant

 Cannabis is a complex plant containing over four hundred chemical compounds, with more than one hundred identified cannabinoids. The two most widely recognized cannabinoids are THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) and CBD (cannabidiol). THC is the primary psychoactive compound responsible for the euphoric sensation commonly associated with marijuana, while CBD is non-intoxicating and has been studied for its potential therapeutic properties. However, these two compounds only scratch the surface. Minor cannabinoids like CBN, CBG, and THCV are gaining significant attention in the industry for their unique effects, and our team loves exploring these topics with curious customers.

 Terpenes are another essential component of the cannabis plant that we emphasize in our educational conversations. These aromatic compounds are responsible for the distinctive scents and flavors found in different strains, from the citrusy burst of limonene to the earthy calm of myrcene. Beyond aroma, terpenes work synergistically with cannabinoids in what researchers call the “entourage effect,” potentially enhancing or modifying the overall experience. When you visit our weed shop, we help you understand how terpene profiles influence the effects you feel, so you can make choices aligned with your personal preferences.

 Navigating Product Categories

 One of the most common areas where customers seek guidance is understanding the wide range of product types available. At We Roll Up, we carry an extensive menu that includes smokable flower , pre-rolls , vapes , gummies, edibles , concentrates , and topicals . Each category offers a different onset time, duration of effects, and method of consumption. Smokable flower and vapes typically deliver effects within minutes, while edibles can take anywhere from thirty minutes to two hours to fully manifest. Concentrates offer higher potency for experienced users, and topicals provide localized relief without psychoactive effects.

 Our friendly staff walks every customer through these distinctions because choosing the right product matters. We always have a Spanish-speaking team member onsite to ensure language is never a barrier to understanding. Whether someone searching for marijuana near me lands at our dispensary for pain management, relaxation, creativity, or social enjoyment, we tailor our recommendations based on individual needs and experience levels. Finding your perfect strain is our mission, and education is how we accomplish it.

 Key Topics We Cover In-Store

 When you visit us, our team is prepared to discuss a broad range of educational topics that help you feel confident about your purchase. Here are some of the areas we frequently explore with customers:

 
 Dosing and microdosing for beginners who want to start low and go slow to find their ideal comfort level

 Indica, sativa, and hybrid distinctions and how modern cannabis science is moving toward terpene and cannabinoid profiling for more accurate effect predictions

 Storage and freshness to help customers preserve potency and flavor at home

 Legal compliance including possession limits, consumption regulations, and age requirements in California

 Medical versus recreational use and how to determine which approach best serves your goals

 
 Industry Trends and the Future of Cannabis Knowledge

 The cannabis industry in the United States is evolving rapidly. According to recent market analyses, the legal cannabis market is projected to exceed fifty billion dollars in annual revenue within the next several years. With this growth comes an increasing demand for consumer education. Emerging trends include lab-tested product transparency, strain-specific research, and personalized cannabis wellness plans based on individual endocannabinoid systems. Consumers searching for weed near me or cannabis delivery options are no longer just looking for convenience. They want trustworthy information to accompany their purchases.

 At We Roll Up, we are committed to staying ahead of these developments. We continuously train our team on the latest research, product innovations, and regulatory changes so that every interaction you have with us is rooted in accurate, up-to-date knowledge. We also offer convenient options like online ordering, in-store pickup, and curbside pickup so that your educational journey and shopping experience are seamless from start to finish.

 Visit Us and Learn Something New

 Cannabis education is not a one-time event. It is an ongoing conversation, and we welcome you to be part of it. Whether you stop by from Carson, San Pedro, Wilmington, Westchester, Rancho Palos Verdes, Mar Vista, Del Rey, Lomita, Palos Verdes Estates, Playa Vista, Marina Del Ray, Fox Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rolling Hills, and LAX or from across the country, our doors are open to recreational users, medical patients, novices, and connoisseurs alike. We create a secure, comfortable, and accepting environment where questions are encouraged and knowledge is freely shared. Come discover the best of cannabinoids, terpenes, and effects with a team that genuinely loves what we do.

pages.bodyText:
Cannabis 101

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 Cannabis Education at We Roll Up

 Step inside We Roll Up and you’ll notice the strains are categorized as indica, sativa, and hybrid. While this is a great guideline for determining effects, we highly recommend familiarizing yourself with the chemical profile of the strain. Compounds such as cannabinoids and terpenes provide a more in-depth understanding of the product.

 Sativa, indica, and hybrid are actually botanical classifications of the plant’s structure. However, the terms have been widely adopted as a simple method of navigating effects. Generally, indica strains tend to be sedating, calming, relaxing, and more of a full-body high for nighttime use. Sativas lean toward energizing, uplifting and cerebral effects that help with socialization, creativity, and physical activity. Hybrids are a mix.

 Questions About Cannabis?

 Once you’re more experienced with cannabis, learning about chemical profiles, cannabinoids and terpenes help to narrow down and customize choices to best fit your preferences and purposes. You’ll discover that each strain interacts in a unique way with your body chemistry. The cannabinoids and terpenes combine into what’s known as the entourage effect.

 While there are hundreds of chemical compounds found in the cannabis plant, the two primary cannabinoids are THC and CBD. THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is responsible for the psychoactive effects and is often used for treating symptoms of pain and nausea. CBD (cannabidiol) is non-intoxicating and shows great promise for alleviating pain, inflammation, anxiety, and numerous medical issues.

 We’re Here to Help!

 Terpenes are aromatic compounds produced by a variety of plants and fruit, such as oranges, eucalyptus, pepper, and lavender. They are the reason for the distinct odors and flavors of cannabis. We are still discovering how combinations of terpenes and cannabinoids impact the effects of different strains, but you’ll definitely identify your favorites with just a sniff.

 For any questions, concerns or even curiosity you might have, We Roll Up is here to share knowledge, information, and recommendations. We welcome all walks of life and look forward to getting to know your preferences and assisting your cannabis journey. The first licensed dispensary in San Pedro , we offer an exciting collection of cannabis options. We invite shopping in-store, ordering online, in-store/curbside pick-up, and plan to add delivery services very soon!

 Our helpful, knowledgeable staff is ready to help!

Recreational & Medicinal

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 Recreational Weed vs Medical Weed

 The differences between medical and recreational cannabis are subtle. Just because you are a medicinal marijuana patient doesn’t mean you can’t enjoy the experience. While you might not be an MMJ cardholder, you can benefit from curative properties. However, qualifying for the card does provide perks, such as lower costs, access to higher potency, and the ability to purchase larger quantities.

 Get Medical Cannabis from Us

 To shop We Roll Up as a medicinal cannabis patient, you need a California MMJ card. Our home state does not include out-of-state reciprocity. We invite adults 21+ years of age with valid government-issued ID from anywhere across the country to choose from our wide selection of recreational weed. We are extremely proud of our distinction as the first legal and licensed cannabis dispensary in San Pedro.

 Recreational Cannabis from We Roll Up

 We Roll Up is built around acceptance. We welcome all walks of life, appreciate your individual concerns, and strive to create a perfectly comfortable, enjoyable, and secure atmosphere. Our staff is extremely knowledgeable, friendly, love to talk about cannabis, and includes Spanish-speaking employees. Whether for recreational or medicinal benefits, we offer exceptional quality of flower , pre-rolls, concentrates, vapes, topicals, and edibles. Purchase in-store or order online. Save time with in-store or curbside pickup and watch for delivery services coming soon!

 Our cannabis selection is sure to suit your medicinal & recreational needs!

pages.bodyText:
Privacy Policy

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 Welcome to our Privacy Policy

 Your privacy is critically important to us.

 We Roll Up is located at:

 
 We Roll Up
1705 S Gaffey Street, San Pedro 
90731– CA , United States
424 264 5423 
 It is We Roll Up‘s policy to respect your privacy regarding any information we may collect while operating our website. This Privacy Policy applies to We Roll Up (hereinafter, “us”, “we”, or “We Roll Up“). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting personally identifiable information you may provide us through the Website. We have adopted this privacy policy (“Privacy Policy”) to explain what information may be collected on our Website, how we use this information, and under what circumstances we may disclose the information to third parties. This Privacy Policy applies only to information we collect through the Website and does not apply to our collection of information from other sources.

 This Privacy Policy, together with the Terms and conditions posted on our Website, set forth the general rules and policies governing your use of our Website. Depending on your activities when visiting our Website, you may be required to agree to additional terms and conditions.

 Website Visitors

 Like most website operators, We Roll Up collects non-personally-identifying information of the sort that web browsers and servers typically make available, such as the browser type, language preference, referring site, and the date and time of each visitor request. We Roll Up‘s purpose in collecting non-personally identifying information is to better understand how We Roll Up‘s visitors use its website. From time to time, We Roll Up may release non-personally-identifying information in the aggregate, e.g., by publishing a report on trends in the usage of its website.

 We Roll Up also collects potentially personally-identifying information like Internet Protocol (IP) addresses for logged in users and for users leaving comments on http://We Roll Up blog posts. We Roll Up only discloses logged in user and commenter IP addresses under the same circumstances that it uses and discloses personally-identifying information as described below.

 Gathering of Personally-Identifying Information

 Certain visitors to We Roll Up‘s websites choose to interact with We Roll Up in ways that require We Roll Up to gather personally-identifying information. The amount and type of information that We Roll Up gathers depends on the nature of the interaction. For example, we ask visitors who sign up for a blog at We Roll Up to provide a username and email address.

 Security

 The security of your Personal Information is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

 Advertisements

 Ads appearing on our website may be delivered to users by advertising partners, who may set cookies. These cookies allow the ad server to recognize your computer each time they send you an online advertisement to compile information about you or others who use your computer. This information allows ad networks to, among other things, deliver targeted advertisements that they believe will be of most interest to you. This Privacy Policy covers the use of cookies by We Roll Up and does not cover the use of cookies by any advertisers.

 Links To External Sites

 Our Service may contain links to external sites that are not operated by us. If you click on a third party link, you will be directed to that third party’s site. We strongly advise you to review the Privacy Policy and terms and conditions of every site you visit.

 We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies or practices of any third party sites, products or services.

 We Roll Up uses Google AdWords for remarketing

 We Roll Up uses the remarketing services to advertise on third party websites (including Google) to previous visitors to our site. It could mean that we advertise to previous visitors who haven’t completed a task on our site, for example using the contact form to make an enquiry. This could be in the form of an advertisement on the Google search results page, or a site in the Google Display Network. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on someone’s past visits. Of course, any data collected will be used in accordance with our own privacy policy and Google’s privacy policy.

 You can set preferences for how Google advertises to you using the Google Ad Preferences page, and if you want to you can opt out of interest-based advertising entirely by cookie settings or permanently using a browser plugin.

 Protection of Certain Personally-Identifying Information

 We Roll Up discloses potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information only to those of its employees, contractors and affiliated organizations that (i) need to know that information in order to process it on We Roll Up‘s behalf or to provide services available at We Roll Up‘s website, and (ii) that have agreed not to disclose it to others. Some of those employees, contractors and affiliated organizations may be located outside of your home country; by using We Roll Up‘s website, you consent to the transfer of such information to them. We Roll Up will not rent or sell potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information to anyone. Other than to its employees, contractors and affiliated organizations, as described above, We Roll Up discloses potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information only in response to a subpoena, court order or other governmental request, or when We Roll Up believes in good faith that disclosure is reasonably necessary to protect the property or rights of We Roll Up, third parties or the public at large.

 If you are a registered user of http://We Roll Up and have supplied your email address, We Roll Up may occasionally send you an email to tell you about new features, solicit your feedback, or just keep you up to date with what’s going on with We Roll Up and our products. We primarily use our blog to communicate this type of information, so we expect to keep this type of email to a minimum. If you send us a request (for example via a support email or via one of our feedback mechanisms), we reserve the right to publish it in order to help us clarify or respond to your request or to help us support other users. We Roll Up takes all measures reasonably necessary to protect against the unauthorized access, use, alteration or destruction of potentially personally-identifying and personally-identifying information.

 Aggregated Statistics

 We Roll Up may collect statistics about the behavior of visitors to its website. We Roll Up may display this information publicly or provide it to others. However, We Roll Up does not disclose your personally-identifying information.

 Cookies

 To enrich and perfect your online experience, We Roll Up uses “Cookies”, similar technologies and services provided by others to display personalized content, appropriate advertising and store your preferences on your computer.

 A cookie is a string of information that a website stores on a visitor’s computer, and that the visitor’s browser provides to the website each time the visitor returns. We Roll Up uses cookies to help We Roll Up identify and track visitors, their usage of http://We Roll Up, and their website access preferences. We Roll Up visitors who do not wish to have cookies placed on their computers should set their browsers to refuse cookies before using We Roll Up‘s websites, with the drawback that certain features of We Roll Up‘s websites may not function properly without the aid of cookies.

 By continuing to navigate our website without changing your cookie settings, you hereby acknowledge and agree to We Roll Up‘s use of cookies.

 E-commerce

 Those who engage in transactions with We Roll Up – by purchasing We Roll Up‘s services or products, are asked to provide additional information, including as necessary the personal and financial information required to process those transactions. In each case, We Roll Up collects such information only insofar as is necessary or appropriate to fulfill the purpose of the visitor’s interaction with We Roll Up. We Roll Up does not disclose personally-identifying information other than as described below. And visitors can always refuse to supply personally-identifying information, with the caveat that it may prevent them from engaging in certain website-related activities.

 Privacy Policy Changes

 Although most changes are likely to be minor, We Roll Up may change its Privacy Policy from time to time, and in We Roll Up‘s sole discretion. We Roll Up encourages visitors to frequently check this page for any changes to its Privacy Policy. Your continued use of this site after any change in this Privacy Policy will constitute your acceptance of such change.

 At We Roll Up, your privacy is our top priority.

pages.bodyText:
Products

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 Cannabis Products for Every Preference and Need

 At We Roll Up , we carry a comprehensive selection of cannabis products designed to meet the needs of every customer who walks through our doors. As San Pedro ‘s first licensed cannabis dispensary, we have built our inventory around quality, variety, and accessibility. Whether you are a recreational user exploring cannabis for the first time, a medical patient seeking targeted relief, or a seasoned connoisseur looking for something exceptional, our hand-picked menu offers something for everyone. We proudly serve customers from Carson, San Pedro, Wilmington, Westchester, Rancho Palos Verdes, Mar Vista, Del Rey, Lomita, Palos Verdes Estates, Playa Vista, Marina Del Ray, Fox Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rolling Hills, and LAX and surrounding communities throughout California, providing a welcoming environment where you can explore the best weed products near me with guidance from our knowledgeable, diverse team.

 Our approach to product selection involves carefully vetting brands and cultivators to ensure that everything on our shelves meets rigorous standards for potency, purity, and consistency. The cannabis industry has grown exponentially, with the legal market now valued at over thirty billion dollars nationwide, and we stay on top of emerging trends so our customers always have access to the latest and most effective cannabis products available. From classic categories to innovative new formulations, our dispensary deals near me are designed to deliver premium quality at affordable prices.

 Flower: The Foundation of Cannabis

 Smokable Flower remains the most popular cannabis product category in the United States, accounting for roughly forty percent of all dispensary sales. At We Roll Up, our flower selection spans indica, sativa, and hybrid strains sourced from top-tier cultivators in California. Each strain is chosen for its unique terpene profile, cannabinoid content, and overall experience. Whether you prefer the relaxing body effects of a heavy indica or the uplifting cerebral energy of a pure sativa, finding your perfect strain is our mission. We stock flower in multiple sizes, from single grams to full ounces, making it easy to sample something new or stock up on a favorite.

 Our team evaluates flower based on appearance, aroma, cure quality, and lab-tested THC and CBD percentages. California’s regulated testing requirements ensure that every product on our shelf has been verified for contaminants including pesticides, heavy metals, and microbial impurities. This means you can shop with confidence knowing that safety and transparency are built into every purchase you make.

 Pre-Rolls: Convenience Without Compromise

 Pre-rolls have surged in popularity over the past several years, and it is easy to understand why. They offer the full flower experience without requiring any preparation, grinding, or rolling equipment. We carry an extensive range of pre-roll options including single joints, multi-packs, infused pre-rolls coated in concentrate and rolled in kief, and mini pre-rolls perfect for shorter sessions. Infused pre-rolls in particular have become one of the fastest-growing segments in the cannabis market, delivering enhanced potency and flavor that elevates the traditional smoking experience.

 Our pre-roll selection includes options from brands that use only premium whole flower rather than trim or shake, ensuring a smooth and flavorful burn from start to finish. For customers visiting from Carson, San Pedro, Wilmington, Westchester, Rancho Palos Verdes, Mar Vista, Del Rey, Lomita, Palos Verdes Estates, Playa Vista, Marina Del Ray, Fox Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Rolling Hills, and LAX looking for dispensary deals near me, pre-roll packs often represent outstanding value while maintaining the quality standards we are known for.

 Vaporizers: Modern and Discreet Consumption

 Vaporizers represent one of the most rapidly evolving categories in cannabis products. We stock a wide variety of vape options including disposable pens, cartridge-and-battery systems, and pod-based devices from industry-leading brands. Vaporizers heat cannabis oil to a temperature that releases cannabinoids and terpenes without combustion, producing a smoother inhale with less odor than traditional smoking methods. This makes them an attractive option for customers who value discretion and portability.

 Our vape cartridges come in multiple formulations including live resin, live rosin, distillate, and full-spectrum extracts. Live resin and live rosin cartridges are made from flash-frozen cannabis flower, preserving the plant’s natural terpene profile and delivering a flavor experience that closely mirrors smoking fresh flower. Distillate cartridges offer high potency and consistent effects, while full-spectrum options maintain a broader range of cannabinoids for what many users describe as a more balanced and nuanced experience. Our staff is always available to walk you through the differences and help you find the vaporizer that best matches your lifestyle and preferences.

 Edibles: Delicious and Long-Lasting Effects

 Edibles have transformed the way people consume cannabis, offering a smoke-free alternative that delivers potent, long-lasting effects through ingestion. Our edible selection includes gummies, chocolates, baked goods, beverages, mints, and other infused treats available in a range of THC and CBD dosages. California law caps individual edible servings at ten milligrams of THC, with most packages containing multiple servings, making it straightforward to control your intake and find a comfortable dose.

 For first-time consumers, our team recommends starting with a low dose and waiting at least ninety minutes before consuming more, since edibles must pass through the digestive system before effects are felt. Experienced users often appreciate higher-dose options or nano-emulsified edibles that use advanced technology to improve bioavailability and onset time. We speak Spanish and English, and our friendly staff is always ready to provide personalized guidance so you leave with the right product for your needs.

 Concentrates: Potency and Purity

 Concentrates are designed for consumers seeking maximum potency and efficiency. These products are created through extraction processes that isolate cannabinoids and terpenes from raw cannabis plant material, resulting in products that typically range from sixty to over ninety percent THC. Our concentrate menu includes:

 
 Live resin and live rosin crafted from fresh-frozen flower to preserve terpene richness and deliver exceptional flavor

 Shatter, wax, and budder offering versatile textures suitable for dabbing with a rig or electronic device

 Diamonds and sauce combining crystalline THC-A with terpene-rich sauce for a premium experience

 Rosin pressed without solvents appealing to health-conscious consumers who prefer solventless extraction methods

 
 Concentrates require specific accessories for consumption, and our team can help you understand the equipment and techniques involved if you are new to this category. The concentrate market continues to grow as extraction technology advances, and we regularly update our inventory to feature the most innovative products available.

 Topicals: Targeted Relief Without Psychoactive Effects

 Topicals represent a unique category of cannabis products that are applied directly to the skin rather than inhaled or ingested. These products include lotions, balms, salves, patches, and bath products infused with THC, CBD, or a combination of both. Because cannabinoids applied topically interact with receptors in the skin without entering the bloodstream in significant amounts, most topicals provide localized relief without producing the psychoactive high associated with other consumption methods.

 This makes topicals particularly popular among medical patients and older adults seeking relief from discomfort, inflammation, or skin conditions. Transdermal patches are an exception, as they are specifically designed to deliver cannabinoids through the skin and into the bloodstream for systemic effects over an extended period. Our topical selection caters to a broad range of needs, and our knowledgeable team members can help you identify the right product based on your specific goals.

 How We Help You Choose

 With so many cannabis products available, finding the right option can feel overwhelming. That is exactly why our diverse and knowledgeable team is here. We guide every customer through our extensive menu with patience and expertise, whether you visit us in store, place an online order, or take advantage of our curbside pickup service. Our open-door philosophy means we welcome recreational users, medical patients, novices, and connoisseurs alike, seven days per week. At We Roll Up, we just love elevating your quality of life through premium cannabis products and exceptional service.

 Why are we so especially proud of our selection of flower?

 Weed Flower at We Roll Up

 Smoking remains the most popular cannabis consumption method. It’s also one of the simplest.  Cannabis Flower: The Heart of the Plant

 If you have ever stood at a dispensary counter wondering which jar holds the strain that matches your evening plans, you already understand why flower remains the centerpiece of cannabis culture. It is the most recognizable, most versatile, and arguably most honest form of the plant. At We Roll Up in LAX and San Pedro, the first licensed cannabis dispensary in San Pedro , flower is where our passion truly shows. Every bud on our shelves has been chosen because it represents the quality, aroma, and effect that we want our community to experience.

 Flower refers to the dried, cured buds of the female cannabis plant. These buds carry the trichomes, the tiny resin glands that contain cannabinoids like THC and CBD, along with the terpenes responsible for scent and flavor. When you smoke or vaporize flower, you are experiencing the plant in its most complete and natural state, untouched by the additional processing that goes into concentrates or edibles.

 From Harvest to Shelf: How Flower Is Prepared

 The journey of a quality bud begins long before it reaches our menu. After cultivators harvest the plants, the flower must be trimmed, dried, and cured. Drying lowers the moisture content slowly, which prevents mold and preserves the delicate terpene profile. Curing then allows the buds to rest in controlled containers, smoothing out harshness and deepening flavor over a period of weeks.

 By the time flower arrives at We Roll Up, it has passed through state-mandated lab testing for potency and contaminants. We review these results so we know exactly what each strain offers. Proper storage continues in-store, where temperature and humidity are managed to keep buds fresh, fragrant, and ready for you to enjoy the moment you take them home.

 Understanding Strain Types and Effects

 Choosing flower is rarely about THC percentage alone. The interplay of cannabinoids and terpenes shapes how a strain actually feels, a phenomenon often called the entourage effect. Our team takes the time to walk you through the categories so you can match the experience to your needs.

 
 Indica-leaning flower: Often associated with relaxation, body-heavy sensations, and evening or nighttime use when you want to unwind.

 Sativa-leaning flower: Frequently chosen for daytime activity, creativity, and a more uplifting, mentally engaging experience.

 Hybrid flower: Blended genetics that balance qualities of both, giving you flexibility for a range of moods and moments.

 High-CBD flower: Lower in psychoactive intensity and popular among those seeking calm without a pronounced high.

 
 These categories are starting points rather than strict rules. Terpenes such as myrcene, limonene, and pinene play a major role in how a strain behaves, which is why two indicas can feel quite different. We encourage you to ask questions, smell the jars when available, and explore until you find your match.

 Ways to Enjoy Flower

 One reason flower endures is its sheer flexibility. You can grind it and roll it into a joint, pack it into a pipe or bong, or load it into a dry-herb vaporizer for a cleaner inhalation experience. Each method changes the pace and intensity of effects, giving you control over your session. For those who prefer convenience, we also stock pre-rolls made from quality flower, ready to enjoy without any preparation.

 Flower is equally useful for the home enthusiast who likes to craft. Many of our customers use it as the base for homemade infusions, butters, and oils. Whether you are a recreational novice trying your first eighth or a seasoned connoisseur seeking a specific terpene profile, our hand-picked selection is designed to fit your routine.

 We are proud to function as part of the local society, serving recreational users, medical patients, novices, and aficionados alike. Our doors are open seven days a week, and we always have a Spanish-speaking member of our team onsite to make sure everyone feels welcome. We offer conveniences like online ordering, in-store pickup, and curbside pickup, so picking up your favorite flower fits easily into your day.

At We Roll Up , finding your perfect flower is more than a transaction. It is part of how we elevate quality of life and bring our community together, one bud at a time.

headings.text: What Makes Our Service Area Unique
Our Product Selection Across the Region

pages.bodyText:
Service Area

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 Our California Service Area

 As San Pedro ‘s first licensed cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up is proud to serve a wide network of communities across the South Bay and greater Los Angeles area. Our commitment to providing a safe, secure, and welcoming environment extends far beyond our dispensary doors. We believe that access to quality cannabis products should be convenient, reliable, and community-driven, which is why we have built strong relationships with customers spanning multiple neighborhoods and cities throughout the region. Whether you are searching for dispensary deals near me or the best weed products near me, our service area is designed to ensure you never have to travel far for an exceptional experience.

 Communities We Proudly Serve

 Our central location allows us to serve an impressive range of cities and neighborhoods across the South Bay peninsula and surrounding areas. From our home base in San Pedro, we extend our reach to Culver City, Rancho Palos Verdes, Lomita, Wilmington, Harbor City, Torrance, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, and Palos Verdes Estates. Each of these communities has its own character, its own culture, and its own relationship with cannabis, and we take the time to understand the unique needs of customers coming from every corner of our service area.

 Residents of the Palos Verdes Peninsula, including Rancho Palos Verdes, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, and Palos Verdes Estates, benefit from our proximity and our curated selection of premium cannabis products. These communities, known for their scenic beauty and tight-knit neighborhoods, deserve a dispensary that reflects those same values of quality and care. Meanwhile, customers from Torrance, Lomita, Harbor City, and Wilmington appreciate the short drive to our location, where our diverse and knowledgeable team is ready to assist with everything from selecting the perfect flower strain to recommending the ideal edible dosage for a first-time user.

 For those coming from Culver City and other parts of the greater Los Angeles area, the journey to We Roll Up is well worth it. Our hand-picked selection of the finest cannabis products at affordable prices sets us apart from other dispensaries in the region. We function as part of the local society and take pride in being a destination that draws visitors from across the South Bay and beyond. We also welcome visitors from anywhere across the country who want to discover the best of cannabinoids, terpenes, and effects.

 What Makes Our Service Area Unique

 The South Bay cannabis market has evolved significantly in recent years, with California’s legal cannabis industry generating billions in annual revenue and continuing to grow. Within this landscape, the communities we serve represent a diverse cross-section of consumers, from medical patients seeking relief through targeted topicals and concentrates to recreational users exploring vaporizers, pre-rolls, and gummies. Our service area encompasses both densely populated urban neighborhoods and quieter residential enclaves, which means our product selection must cater to an extraordinary range of preferences and needs.

 We speak Spanish, and we always have a Spanish-speaking member of our team onsite. This is especially important given the rich cultural diversity of the communities we serve, including Wilmington, San Pedro, and Harbor City, where bilingual service is not just appreciated but essential. Creating an inclusive atmosphere means meeting people where they are, both geographically and linguistically. Recreational users, medical patients, novices, or connoisseurs are all warmly welcome at our location.

 Convenience Across Our Service Area

 Understanding that our customers lead busy lives, we have implemented multiple ways to make purchasing cannabis products as seamless as possible regardless of where you live within our service area. Our convenience options include:

 
 Online ordering allows you to browse our full menu of flower, pre-rolls, vaporizers, edibles, concentrates, and topicals from the comfort of your home in any of the cities we serve

 In-store pickup lets you place your order ahead of time and walk in to collect it without waiting

 Curbside pickup provides a quick and easy option for those who prefer to stay in their vehicle, particularly convenient for customers driving in from Torrance, Culver City, or the Palos Verdes communities

 In-store consultation gives you direct access to our friendly and knowledgeable staff who can guide you through our extensive menu of cannabis products

 
 These options are especially valuable for medical patients throughout our service area who may have mobility challenges or time constraints. We are committed to smoothing your path and ensuring that finding dispensary deals near me never requires unnecessary stress or inconvenience. Our doors are open seven days per week to anyone and everyone from all walks of life.

 Our Product Selection Across the Region

 No matter which community you call home within our service area, you will find a comprehensive selection of cannabis products tailored to meet your specific needs. Our menu features exceptional smokable flower sourced from top cultivators, available in indica, sativa, and hybrid varieties that span a wide range of potency levels and terpene profiles. For those who prefer convenience, our selection of pre-rolls includes singles, multi-packs, and infused options that deliver consistent quality every time.

 Vaporizers have become increasingly popular across our service area, particularly among customers in communities like Palos Verdes Estates and Rolling Hills where discretion and ease of use are valued. We carry a wide variety of vapes, from disposable pens to rechargeable cartridge systems, in numerous strain options and formulations. Our edibles selection features delicious gummies and other treats that provide measured doses for predictable experiences, which is particularly appealing for newer consumers exploring weed products near me for the first time.

 Concentrates and topicals round out our offerings, addressing the needs of both experienced users seeking potent effects and medical patients looking for targeted relief without psychoactive experiences. Topicals such as balms, lotions, and patches have seen growing demand from customers throughout the South Bay who are managing chronic pain, inflammation, and skin conditions.

 Growing With Our Communities

 As the cannabis industry continues to mature in California, We Roll Up remains focused on expanding the quality and depth of service we provide across every city in our service area. Industry trends point toward increased normalization of cannabis consumption, greater emphasis on product testing and transparency, and rising demand for specialized product categories like minor cannabinoids and terpene-rich formulations. We stay ahead of these trends by continuously updating our inventory and training our team to provide informed recommendations.

 Finding your perfect strain is our mission. We just love elevating the quality of life for every customer who walks through our doors, whether they are a local from San Pedro or someone making the drive from Culver City. We bring communities together through a supportive atmosphere and quality cannabis products that enrich socialization, bring medicinal relief, and provide options to suit all needs. Our service area is more than a map of cities. It represents the diverse, vibrant community of people we are honored to serve every single day.

 Situations Where Delivery Makes the Most Sense

 Delivery solves practical problems that a counter visit cannot always address. Consider a medical patient managing chronic discomfort who finds it difficult to drive on a flare-up day.  Why Westchester Customers Choose Us

Weed Delivery

 

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 Convenient delivery to your door in San Pedro and Surrounding Communities

 Getting your favorite cannabis products should be convenient, straightforward, and stress-free. At We Roll Up , we understand that not everyone has the time to visit a physical dispensary, which is why our weed delivery service brings the dispensary experience directly to your door. As San Pedro’s first licensed cannabis dispensary, we have built our reputation on accessibility and quality, and our delivery service is a natural extension of that commitment. Whether you are a recreational user looking for a relaxing evening or a medical patient seeking consistent relief, our delivery option ensures you never have to go without the products you depend on.

 Order Now 

 

 

 
 

 

 





 

 
 
 How Our Delivery Process Works

 

 

 
 
 Step 1: Browse & Order

 Explore our extensive online menu featuring smokable flower, pre-rolls, vapes, gummies and edibles, concentrates, and topicals. Every listing includes detailed strain, potency, terpene, and effects information so you can shop with confidence — just like getting guidance from our in-store team.

 

 

 
 
 Step 2: Verification & Fulfillment

 Complete your order through our secure online platform. We verify your age and ID in compliance with California state regulations, then carefully package your order and dispatch it with a driver who follows strict protocols to maintain product integrity and security in transit.

 

 

 
 
 Step 3: Receive Your Delivery

 When your order arrives, simply present a valid government-issued ID confirming you are 21 or older for recreational purchases, or a valid medical marijuana identification card for medicinal orders.

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 What You Can Order for Delivery

 
 

 
 
 
 Our delivery menu mirrors the comprehensive selection available at our San Pedro storefront. We believe that choosing delivery should never mean compromising on variety or quality. Our hand-picked selection of the finest cannabis products at affordable prices spans every major product category, giving you access to hundreds of options from trusted brands and cultivators. We carry products suitable for first-time users who want a gentle introduction as well as experienced connoisseurs seeking potent, premium-grade options.

 
 Flower — Our curated selection of smokable flower includes indica, sativa, and hybrid strains sourced from top California growers, with a range of THC and CBD potencies to match every preference

 Pre-Rolls — Ready-to-enjoy joints and blunts available in singles, multipacks, and infused varieties for those who want convenience without sacrificing quality

 Vaporizers — Disposable pens, cartridges, and pod systems featuring distillate, live resin, and full-spectrum oil options

 Edibles — Gummies, chocolates, baked goods, beverages, and other infused treats with precisely dosed THC and CBD for predictable effects

 Concentrates — Wax, shatter, live resin, rosin, diamonds, and other extraction formats for users seeking elevated potency

 Topicals — Creams, balms, lotions, and patches designed for localized relief without psychoactive effects

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 Serving a Wide Range of Communities

 
 

 
 
 
 One of the aspects that sets our delivery service apart is the geographic reach we provide across the South Bay and greater Los Angeles area. Residents searching for weed products near me or dispensary deals near me throughout Torrance, Harbor City, Lomita, and Wilmington can count on reliable service from a licensed, community-oriented dispensary. We function as part of the local society and are proudly serving San Pedro and the surrounding areas , treating every delivery with the same care and attention we bring to in-store interactions.

 We also recognize that different neighborhoods have different needs. Medical patients in Rancho Palos Verdes or Palos Verdes Estates may rely on consistent delivery schedules for their wellness routines, while recreational customers in Culver City might order ahead for social gatherings or weekend relaxation. Rolling Hills and Rolling Hills Estates residents benefit from the privacy and discretion that home delivery naturally provides. Regardless of where you are located within our service area, our team treats every customer with respect and professionalism.

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 Why Licensed Delivery Matters

 
 

 
 
 
 California’s regulated cannabis market exists to protect consumers, and choosing a licensed delivery service is one of the most important decisions you can make as a buyer. Licensed dispensaries like We Roll Up are required to source products that have undergone rigorous third-party laboratory testing for potency, pesticides, heavy metals, microbials, and residual solvents. Every item that leaves our facility carries a certificate of analysis confirming it meets state safety standards. Unlicensed delivery services operate outside of these regulatory frameworks, meaning there is no guarantee about what you are actually consuming.

 Beyond product safety, licensed delivery also means that your purchase supports legal commerce and tax revenue that flows back into local communities. California collected over five billion dollars in cannabis tax revenue in the years following legalization, funding public health programs, education, and community reinvestment initiatives. When you order from a licensed operation, you are contributing to that ecosystem rather than supporting an unregulated market.

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 Tips for a Great Delivery Experience

 
 

 
 
 
 To make the most of your weed delivery order, we recommend taking a few simple steps before placing your request. First, have your valid identification ready so the verification process is quick and effortless when your driver arrives. Second, take time to read product descriptions carefully. Our team has included strain-specific information, recommended use cases, and dosage guidance to help you find the right fit. If you are exploring cannabis products for the first time, starting with lower-potency options is always a wise approach.

 
 Browse the full menu before ordering to discover new products and take advantage of dispensary deals near me

 Check delivery windows to select a time that works with your schedule

 Ask questions by contacting our team if you need guidance on strains, effects, or product categories

 Plan ahead for events or weekends when demand may be higher

 

 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 A Delivery Service Built on Community Values

 
 

 
 
 
 At We Roll Up, we are more than a dispensary. We are a community hub that brings people together through quality cannabis products and genuine human connection. We speak Spanish and always have a Spanish-speaking member of our team onsite and available to assist with delivery inquiries. Our doors are open seven days per week, and our delivery service extends that availability to customers who prefer receiving their orders at home. Recreational users, medical patients, novices, and connoisseurs are all warmly welcome.

 Finding your perfect strain is our mission. Whether you visit us in San Pedro or place a delivery order from anywhere within our service area, we are committed to elevating your quality of life through safe, legal, and affordable access to the best cannabis products California has to offer. Let us welcome you and guide you through a positive and rewarding experience, delivered right to your doorstep.
